name: Staff of Withering

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Cleric, Druid, or Warlock

powers.name: Withering
powers.text: Arm it: your next hit with the staff spends 1 charge for an extra 2d10 Necrotic, and the target makes a DC 15 Con save or has Disadvantage on Strength and Constitution checks and saves for 1 hour.

summary: 3 charges: a hit can deal an extra 2d10 Necrotic and weaken the target's Strength and Constitution for an hour.
text: This staff has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. The staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals damage as a normal Quarterstaff, and you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 Necrotic damage to the target and force it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage for 1 hour on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution.
